billow.options.title: Billow
billow.options.style.tooltip: How the clouds look. Rounded: vanilla's cloud layout with soft rounded edges. Realistic: soft, wispy clouds of slowly swirling gas. Shapes: clouds shaped like creeper heads, hearts, stars and more. Vanilla: the game's own clouds.
billow.options.height.tooltip: The height of the cloud base. Default uses the dimension's own cloud height. Works with every style, Vanilla included.
billow.options.thickness.tooltip: How thick the clouds are. Realistic clouds grow up to six times this tall.
billow.options.roundness.tooltip: How round the cloud edges are, for Rounded and Shapes clouds. 0% gives sharp boxes.
billow.options.coverage.tooltip: How much of the sky Realistic clouds cover.
billow.options.shapes_with_clouds.toolti: With Shapes, keep regular clouds between the shapes. Turn off for a sky of shapes only.
billow.options.speed.tooltip: How fast the clouds drift. 100% is vanilla speed, 0% stops them.
billow.options.opacity.tooltip: How see-through the clouds are. Works with every style.
billow.options.reset.tooltip: Put every setting back to how it was when you installed Billow.
